item.title: Vague reminders now find a better time
item.summary: When you ask for a reminder in the morning, afternoon, or another broad window, Murph can use your known routine and connected calendar to choose a specific time that fits.
item.details: Exact times stay exact. Calendar checks use an existing connection, and the saved reminder remains a fixed time you can change.

tryIt.label: Plan a reminder
tryIt.prompt: Tomorrow afternoon, remind me to do my mobility exercises. Choose a time that fits.
